title: 5 · Same die, four materials
summary: Upset the same billet in steel, aluminium, copper and modelling plasticine, each at its usual forging temperature.
instructions: 1. Run its multi-run: the material sweep sets each alloy's default forging temperature automatically.
2. Compare the peak loads: hot steel and copper are similar, aluminium is lower, plasticine is hundreds of times lower.
3. Physical modelling: plasticine at room temperature flows like hot steel (similar strain hardening and rate sensitivity), so it is used to study die fill on a bench before cutting steel dies.
4. Divide the steel load by the plasticine load: that is the scale factor between a plasticine trial and production.
